convention_rule: Assumed: four lamps left-to-right map to candidate IDs P1-P4 in numeric order; the single lit lamp marks the target. No prior examples to confirm.
basis: A and B both show four lamps with only the third from left lit green. Numeric-ID mapping gives P3. Mapping by listed candidate order (P3,P4,P1,P2) would give P1 instead, so the result is uncertain. Client-correct P2 is ruled out either way.
